scope: Bounded retail-client and retained-corpus evidence for the achievement-title and achievement-rate request/update routes.

current.role: Point-in-time current-corpus occurrence, capture, and chronology counts recorded by this evidence ledger.

pinned.role: Repository-local byte-identical fixture used by validation and generated structs; its 0x019D sample count predates the current-corpus login witness.

rows.name: AchievementTitleRequestPacket
rows.flow: MyPlayer slot 103 implements _setAchievementTitle. It reads the first runtime argument as a u32, writes the full value to PlayerBase+0xE8, and passes it unchanged to FUN_0075EBA0. The builder zeroes a 16-byte buffer, fills bytes 0..14 with position-specific A..O or a..o characters selected by rand() case branches, leaves byte 15 NUL, computes CRC32 over all 16 bytes, and sends the u32 value, CRC32, and buffer through FUN_004D6D30.

rows.name: SetActorStatePacket
rows.flow: CharaElement slot 9 routes opcode 0x0134 to FUN_00588BA0. The route isolates the low main-state byte, replaces the adjacent wire byte with zero in its temporary record, writes state to CharaElement+0xF4 and conditionally +0xF0, calls the state-transition helpers, and broadcasts scene records 0x39 and 0x3A. It does not construct or invoke AchievementTitleReceiver.

rows.name: SetPlayerTitlePacket
rows.flow: CharaElement slot 9 routes opcode 0x019D through FUN_005751E0 to LuaActorImpl slot 75 and AchievementTitleReceiver. The receiver copies the full title-value dword to PlayerBase+0xE8 after a successful PlayerBase cast. The retained typed layout identifies only the low byte at +0xE8 as achievement_title; the meanings of the adjacent three overwritten bytes remain unresolved.

rows.name: AchievementRateRequestPacket
rows.flow: MyPlayer slot 112 implements _getAchievementRate. It reads the first runtime argument as a u32 achievement-id lookup key and forwards it unchanged to FUN_0075ECD0, which sends it as the only application field through FUN_004D6D30.

rows.name: SendAchievementRatePacket
rows.flow: CharaElement slot 9 routes opcode 0x019F through FUN_00575200 to LuaActorImpl slot 77 and AchievementAchievedCountReceiver. The receiver copies the first three dwords into its temporary object and forwards them to _onReceiveAchievementRate; the closing dword is not copied by this route. No persistent client-state write is established before the Lua callback.

relationships.sameNumberBoundary: Wire integer 0x0134 is direction-scoped: c2s is the _setAchievementTitle builder, while s2c is SetActorState. Same-number reuse is not an acknowledgement relationship.
relationships.titleLifecycle: The actual inbound AchievementTitleReceiver route is s2c 0x019D, not s2c 0x0134. The shared title value and PlayerBase+0xE8 state slot support a bounded request/update correlation, but the retained corpus contains no c2s 0x0134 event and therefore cannot establish acknowledgement, response timing, acceptance, rejection, or server policy.
relationships.rateLifecycle: c2s 0x0135 carries one achievement id and s2c 0x019F carries achievement id plus progress count and flags. The retained corpus contains neither opcode, so client structure supports a subsystem correlation only; it does not establish that 0x019F acknowledges or responds to 0x0135.
relationships.chronology: The retained corpus has zero c2s 0x0134, zero c2s 0x0135, and zero s2c 0x019F observations. It has 912 s2c 0x0134 actor-state observations and 14 s2c 0x019D title updates. Chronology alone supplies no causal edge among these operations.

unresolvedBoundaries: The exact server method and acknowledgement policy for both client requests are not embedded in the retail client.
The semantic noun for the generated 16-byte ASCII buffer is unresolved; calling it a nonce, challenge, or authorization token would exceed the direct evidence.
The individual meanings of progress_flags bits and the closing s2c 0x019F dword are unresolved.
The three bytes adjacent to PlayerBase achievement_title at +0xE9..+0xEB remain unknown even though both title paths overwrite the containing dword.
